tha-ap493:1.1: Paṃsukūlavaggo ekūnapaññāso. L [488. Tīṇikiṅkhanipupphiya.] Kanikāraṃ va jotentaṃ nisinnaṃ pabbatantare / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ Vipassim lokanāyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap493:2.1: Tīṇi kiṅkhanipupphāni paggayha abhiropayiṃ / sambuddhaṃ abhipūjitvā gacchāmi dakkhiṇāmukho. // //
tha-ap493:3.1: Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca / jahitvā manusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap493:4.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ Buddham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap493:8.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Tīṇikiṅkhanipupphiyo th. i. g. a-ti. Tīṇikiṅkhanipupphiyattherassa
